The proof is asymptotic for exactly 3 area-uniform points; finite quadratures are not proof.

final_claim: For three iid unit-disk uniform points, marked MEC tails obey two-support 128√2/(5π) ε^(5/2)+O(ε³) and three-support 16/π² ε³ log(1/ε)+O(ε³), with vanishing conditional three-contact fraction.
limitations: Exactly three independent area-uniform points in the unit disk; near R=1 only. Finite simulation, angular integrals and numerical integration do not establish infinite asymptotic.
Le Caër 2017 treats the same random circumcircles, with parts of its long paper not read line-by-line; an equivalent conditional upper-tail formulation cannot be completely ruled out.
